description.value:
You touch a willing creature and charge it with elemental energy of a type you choose: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic. For the duration, the target can spend an action to release the stored energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d6 damage of the chosen type, halved on a success.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level beyond 2nd.
